text:
katie: Heads-up — I'm opening a PR to refactor modules/network to v2. Main changes: provider hoisting to root, input rename vpc_id -> vpc, and split subnets -> public_subnets/private_subnets. I'll also bump the provider constraints in the root and regen the lockfile. PR: https://git.redwood/dev/infra/pulls/842

michael: Thanks. Do we need a state move for the var rename or are we keeping outputs compatible?

katie: plan keeps resources stable. I'm adding compat outputs in the module for one deploy cycle (old outputs map to new names) so no state mv. Example shim in modules/network/outputs.tf:
```hcl
output "vpc_id" {
  value = module.network.vpc
  deprecated = true
}
```

antoine: For provider hoist, watch aliasing — any module that relies on provider "aws.us-east-1" needs provider = aws.us-east-1 in the call sites or a `providers = { aws = aws.us-east-1 }` mapping. Did you update call sites?

katie: Yep, updated the few call sites in services/* and left a comment where we can't due to legacy patterns.

teresa: Lockfile question: when you bump the constraint (e.g. hashicorp/aws ~> 4.50), are you planning to regenerate .terraform.lock.hcl in CI or locally and push the updated lockfile? CI regen can cause flakes if it picks different platforms.

katie: Regenerate locally with the platforms we support and push. I'll run: `TF_REGISTRY_LOCK_PLATFORMS=linux_amd64,linux_arm64 terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` and commit the lockfile.

infra-bot: lint/terraform check started for branch refactor/network-v2 (job id 5567)

michael: Sounds good. Also check the provider constraints in module root vs versions in registry — sometimes modules pin a lower provider in submodule which causes lockfile to retain old provider version. Search for `required_providers` blocks in modules.

katie: Good call, I'll run `rg \"required_providers\" modules -n` and open fixes for any mismatches.

antoine: One more gotcha: if you change the module source path (module rename), CI plan may show resource replacement due to address change. Keep the module source path stable or add state mv instructions in the PR description.

katie: I'll keep source path stable. If we must move, I'll add `terraform state mv` commands in the PR notes.

teresa: Quick ask for reviewers — can someone QA the plan output for staging after you push? I can do prod once staging looks good.

michael: I can take staging tomorrow morning. Ping me once CI finishes.

katie: Thanks — pushed lockfile and provider pin updates. CI is running, will ping here when plan is green.

infra-bot: terraform plan for infra/staging job 5567 finished — exit status 0, 2 outputs changed, 0 replacements. Plan URL: https://ci.redwood/internal/5567/plan

michael: Quick skim looks fine. No provider mismatches in the plan. One minor: subnet count logic changed, double-check NACL rules still reference the correct list length.

katie: Fixed the NACL reference (off-by-one) and pushed a tiny follow-up.

teresa: Approved the staging plan. Good to roll to prod after a short maintenance window.

katie: Thanks all — rolling to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC. Will post any rollback steps if needed.

infra-bot: deploy job started for infra/prod (job 5579)

katie: Prod apply succeeded, no drift. Closing the refactor PR. :tada:

michael: Nice one, thanks for coordinating!
